name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Beatrix goes with at least two of Weaver, Awl, and Riverside.

Blacksmith, Hammer, and Mallet go with Kingsford, Oldwall, and Riverside, in some order.
Mallet goes with Kingsford if and only if Weaver goes with Hammer.
Beatrix goes with exactly two of Weaver, Mallet, and Riverside.

hints.text: Suppose Beatrix didn't go with Weaver — that hits a contradiction, so it does.

Beatrix goes with Awl, so it can't also go with Mallet. But Beatrix was already shown to go with Mallet — a contradiction.
